methodology: Integrity correction of v4.0. The prior v4.0 income-group scenario multipliers and editorial US role-family benchmarks were not defensible as national occupation salary estimates and have been withdrawn from numeric display. Only six exact US BLS May 2025 records are retained as verified. All other occupation-country pairs are retained as availability records with null salary values until an occupation-specific national observation or a documented country wage anchor plus validated occupation mapping is available. ILOSTAT provides occupation-based earnings tables in local currency; values must be extracted, period/currency/gross-net definitions retained, and ISCO mapping reviewed before publication.
display_policy: Display numeric salary only for evidence_status=verified or a future explicitly labelled modelled estimate built from a country-specific wage anchor and a validated occupation mapping. For insufficient_evidence, display “Données salariales nationales non vérifiées pour ce métier” and no number.

Ne pas remplacer un salaire de métier par une moyenne nationale générale.
